name: Voidbound Azeroot
tooltip:
Voidbound Azeroot
5 yd range
2.5 sec cast
The hearty earthroot plant has grown stronger in recent years. Difficult to gather, but just as potent in crafting, azeroot is key to many recipes in Quel'Thalas.

This sturdy wooden herb can be found on or around trees in the Quel'Thalas region.

While the power of the void has been present on Azeroth since time immemorial, recent events have caused it to surge. It has managed to seep into the world, which has had adverse affects on the local ecology.

In some cases, the unstable energies of the void have caused these herbs to be sent across the Twisting Nether to parts unknown. In this case, you happened to find this specimen in the Voidstorm.

Discovery: Midnight Gathering Nodes
